# Local password estimator

Pinned runtime inputs in package-lock.json; npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build regenerates the checked-in IIFE. Node/esbuild are development-only. Native app uses JavaScriptCore, no DOM, network matcher or downloaded code. Wrapper returns metrics and pattern categories only, never raw sequences/password. MIT code; dictionary attribution/ODC-BY/EFF notices are separate. Full notices in ThirdPartyNotices/PasswordEstimator and app resource. SHA-256 in manifest.json.

The pinned Common npm artifact omits its NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES files. Upstream source attribution retrieved 2026-10-22 is included separately as upstream-common-* notices, with EFF/public-domain data provenance. English artifact includes ODC-BY/OpenSubtitles notices. No assertion that all dictionary data are MIT.
